snippet.title: Trinity Universe (2009/10) Playthrough (PS3)
snippet.description:
Well, here's another crossover J-RPG on the PS3 system by Sony. In this game, you get a bunch of girls (That's almost to be expected in an Idea Factory or Nippon Ichi game.), a kickass soundtrack, visual novel-like cutscenes, flying objects in space, dungeons to explore and fight off your enemies. And that's Trinity Universe for you. Originally released on June 29th, 2010 in North America, October 1st, 2009 in Japan and for the European side, June 25th, 2010. Could this be a sequel to Cross Edge on the same system? Who knows. As for the game, you do get used to how your player moves in a 3D space, performing combos by SQUARE, CROSS or TRIANGLE or charge/escape by CIRCLE. And yes, you do get random encounters, shops. inns, specials and a way to save your game. Anyways, this is certainly not a bad title. If you find a game that features a bunch of girls or a crossover game, then this will appeal to you. 

All rights belong to Idea Factory and Nippon Ichi Software.
